title: Chess vs Chaturanga
summary: Tony's modern chess army vs Fairy-Stockfish with a Chaturanga army on the same squares: queen -> Fers (1 square diagonal), bishops -> Elephants (jump exactly 2 diagonally; only 8 reachable squares), rooks -> Chariots (rook moves), knights/king/pawns as normal. He trades knights and rooks, keeps bishops and queen vs elephants and fers, promotes pawns and finishes with a ladder mate using a second queen (~8:47).
rules: Opponent (Black): Chaturanga army — Fers instead of queen (1 step diagonal), Elephants instead of bishops (leap exactly 2 squares diagonally, can jump over), Chariots instead of rooks (rook moves), normal horses/knights, king and pawns.
Castling appears disabled in this video (9:08 'maybe I'll even enable castling for one of these') — inferred.
Player's pawns promote normally (he makes a second queen). Opponent promotion rule not stated (inferred: to fers as in chaturanga).
